node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-improvement-iteration to the literal map u_R with d=D*t and epsilon=epsilon_R. It produces one specific dagger-preserving map v_R:B_R->A_R, with amplifications (v_R)_n=I_n tensor v_R, such that sup_n||(v_R)_n-(u_R)_n||<=K_disp*D*t and v_R is an extended K_floor*epsilon_R-inclusion; this is the map retained throughout the proof, including at epsilon_R=0 where the provider specifies the operator-norm limit.
